name: Gift cards
description: Gift cards with a balance: sold as a product (a fixed amount or one the customer types, to themselves or to somebody else, on a date of their choosing), issued by hand one at a time or in a batch for printing, and spent in the same box as a coupon. A card is money paid in advance, not a discount: it pays part or all of an order beside the ordinary payment method, a refund goes back onto it first, and every movement of its balance is a line in its own history.

settings.label: A new card is valid for, months
settings.help: Counted from the order that bought it, or from the day it was issued by hand. 0 — cards do not expire. A card's own date can be changed on its page.

settings.label: Smallest amount a customer may type
settings.help: In the shop's currency, for a gift card product that takes an amount of the customer's choosing. A product can narrow it on its own tab.

settings.label: Largest amount a customer may type
A card may pay for delivery
settings.help: Off — a card pays only for the goods, and delivery is paid the ordinary way. A card issued by hand can say otherwise.

settings.label: Put the money back onto the card when an order moves into
settings.help: What a card paid for an order goes back onto it by itself when the order enters one of these statuses. Nothing ticked — only by a refund. Money paid through a bank is refunded by a manager, as before.

settings.label: Cancel a sold card when its order is refunded
settings.help: What is left on a card bought by an order that is then refunded in full is written off. Whatever was already spent stays spent.

settings.label: A card may pay for another gift card
settings.help: Off by default: buying cards with cards turns a promotional card into cash.
